name: New Era Cap, LLC
note: Family-owned headwear company led by fourth-generation CEO Christopher H. Koch (Jackie Robinson Foundation biography). ACON Investments, its first institutional investor (January 2021), calls New Era a portfolio company and said in June 2024 it would maintain a significant stake in the company acquiring '47; ACON's August 2022 continuation fund made MLB, the NFL and the NBA minority owners (ACON releases).
